CBScript, by SethBling (https://github.com/SethBling/cbscript), is built into this mod through Moddy's fork,
jivinstev/moddy-cbscript, as that fork's Java port of the compiler (third_party/moddy-cbscript in the source, compiled
into the jar). Moddy uses it to compile the datapacks behind an item's or a creature's powers.

CBScript carries no open-source licence. It is used in Moddy, and modified for it, with its author's permission
(given verbally, November 2026). The original code remains the copyright of its author. Moddy's own changes in the fork,
the Java port included, are licensed under the Mozilla Public License 2.0, like the rest of Moddy.

The Java port's sinh, cosh and tanh follow fdlibm's formulas (no code copied), under fdlibm's notice:
"Copyright (C) 1993 by Sun Microsystems, Inc. All rights reserved. Developed at SunSoft, a Sun Microsystems, Inc.
business. Permission to use, copy, modify, and distribute this software is freely granted, provided that this notice
is preserved." The fork's NOTICE.md, LICENSE and THIRD_PARTY.md travel with it (META-INF/third_party/moddy-cbscript/).
